title: campanula pulla var. pseudopulla
intro: Campanula pulla var. pseudopulla, commonly known as Alpine Bellflower, is a plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. Alpine Bellflower is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems and digestive disorders, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Bellflower include soothing and calming effects, making it useful in treating anxiety and insomnia, as well as its ability to act as an expectorant to relieve respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents present in Alpine Bellflower include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
